spec: §15 suite E (JCS parsing); §8.1: a target is a JSON document in RFC 8785 canonical form; target_hash = SHA-256 of those bytes
derivation: target.json in this directory is written in canonical form (sorted keys, no insignificant whitespace, integer literals).
